RPG launchers for a City Gangrel Obf-Cel-Pro deck. This deck,
unfortunately, did not work very well, due to a lack of good-sized
vampires with the proper disciplines.
Sigh.
So I shelved the idea, and I made this new deck based off
Gangrel Fortitude-Protean RPG launchers. However, it doesn't quite
work yet. Can you tell me how to improve it without losing the
RPG's? Bear in mind that it doesn't have to be tournament-quality...
just damn fun-deck quality.

Persistence

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Car...@airmail.com wrote:
> In response to you last question, I ask "How many votes can a Vampire
> get in a single action?"

Use Arika calling a Ventrue Justicar vote:

4(IC) +2(Legendary) +4(BO) +1(Ventrue) +X(Awe)

Where X is (2*Capacity)+1, and capacity is arbitrary, based on the
number of cards in the game, which in turn is based on the number
of Meths in the game, given that all unaccounted-for cards are
Camarilla Vitae Slaves except for a number of Hostile Takeovers
equal to the number of Meths minus one.

=X+11

(Miscellaneous 1-vote-gain cards, e.g. Ely:Versailles, have not been
included, since doing so would decrease X by 2 for net loss of 1 vote.)

For your OBF CEL PRO Deck: How about an Assamite-Gangrel Antitribu Deck?

Through in a couple of Protean Masters for your Assamite and center your
Combats on Celerity with the Threat of a final Wolf-Clawed blow. Use some cheap
effective Weapons (Ivory Bow, Meat Cleaver)

Use Shadow of the Beast only for your RPG-Launchers, and some Claws for that
funny Ashes to Ashes song... :) This may be your only Protean Cards.

Use Hidden Lurker to get into Combat (you can redraw your card!) and Disguised Weapon

This may be your only Obfuscate Cards.

Perhaps one Walk of Flame (Well, you're right, Kalinda DON'T have Protean... :)
